title: add downgrade guard and schema migration tooling for private-installer
author: Ariel Kim
description: Motivation: private-installer upgrades were observed to occasionally leave clusters in a state where rolling back is unsafe due to irreversible schema migrations or unpinned component images. This PR introduces a set of downgrade-guards and improved upgrade/rollback tooling to make Private deployments safer. Highlights: - Add version pinning for critical components (postgres, control-plane images, helm charts). - Add pre-upgrade backup hooks and a restore verification step integrated with the installer. - Introduce a migration runner that records applied migration ids and aborts downgrade paths if incompatible migrations are detected. - Add a downgrade guard flag in the installer that checks backups, DB schema compatibility, and image-version pins before allowing an automatic rollback. - Small helm/terraform changes to surface migration metadata and to ensure canary-safe rollouts. Checklist: - [x] Design doc: ENG-4523 linked - [x] Add migration recorder and guard checks - [x] Wire backup/restore verification into installer flow - [x] Add helm chart values for pinned versions and migration annotations - [x] E2E tests in perf-canary and private-installer staging - [x] Docs and release notes Drafted testing performed: - Unit tests for migration recorder and guard logic. - Integration test against a local kind cluster with a small Postgres instance to validate backup+restore and rollback gating. - Ran upgrade from v2025-10-01 -> head and validated that rollback is blocked when migration set is incompatible; when compatible, rollback proceeds after restore verification. Backwards compatibility: installer defaults are conservative — downgrade_guard is off by default to avoid surprising existing automation; recommended enablement for customers in upgrade notes. Rollout plan: merged to main, will be included in next private-installer release. Operators should enable the downgrade_guard via helm values and perform a full backup before enabling. Known limitations: - Does not currently handle cross-region multi-master postgres topologies (tracked ENG-4601). - Large DBs may need custom backup hooks (we surface a hook point in the installer). See linked Linear issues for follow-ups.

review_comments: Marcus Li (review): General approach looks good. Two asks: 1) make sure the migration recorder is idempotent across retries, 2) add a clear signal for automated tooling to know why a downgrade was blocked.
Ariel Kim (author): Addressed both — recorder is now resilient to duplicate application ids and we write a structured reason to installer logs and a /status endpoint. Added tests for idempotency.
Sofia Ramirez (review): Can we make the downgrade_guard default to off and add an explicit helm values flag? Also please add a note about performance implications for very large DBs.
Ariel Kim (author): Done — helm default is off and documented warning added. We surface a hook for custom backup tooling for large DBs.

Drew Patel (security review): Confirming that pinned image lists are configurable but not writable by non-admin operators; ensure values are validated. Also ensure secrets for backup credentials respect RBAC.
Ariel Kim (author): Added validation and documented RBAC expectations in the installer docs. Backups now require a KMS-backed secret or kube secret with appropriate RBAC notes.
release_notes: Add downgrade guard and schema migration tooling for private-installer; introduces migration recorder, pre-upgrade backup/restore verification, version pinning for critical components, and helm/terraform outputs to surface migration metadata. Operators should perform a full backup before enabling the guard.
